newsitem.title: USA: Trade sees weekly U.S. soy net sales up to 600,000.
newsitem.headline: Trade sees weekly U.S. soy net sales up to 600,000.

text.p: USDA's weekly export sales report to be released at 0730 CST Friday is expected to show U.S. net sales of soybeans for the week ended Nov 21 at 400,000 up to 600,000 tonnes, trade sources said.
That tally slightly below the 616,600 tonnes reported by USDA for the week ended November 14.
Corn net sales were expected from 700,000 to 900,000 tonnes below the 1,224,700 reported sold the previous week.
Trade sources said the wheat net sales number should be from 350,000 to 400,000 tonnes, up from the 275,100 tonnes the previous week.
Soymeal net sales during the week were expected to total from 100,000 to 200,000 tonnes. For the week ended November 14 the net sales of U.S. soymeal were at 163,300 tonnes.
Soyoil net sales were expected to range from 20,000 to 50,000 tonnes. The previous week net soyoil sales totaled 34,000 tonnes.
USDA is delaying until Friday its weekly export sales report because of the U.S. Thanksgiving Day Holiday Thursday.
